gateText:
PASS length: 1190 words (700-1800)
PASS direct-answer: first paragraph 68 words (50-75)
PASS title-meta: title 45 (<=60), description 150 (140-155)
PASS headings: 7 H2s, 7 questions, 0 colon-style
PASS faq: 4 items, 40-60 words each
PASS sources: 7 sources, all stats cited
PASS internal-links: 5 links incl. a service page
PASS duplicate: max similarity 1% (how-to-get-google-business-profile), limit 50%
PASS banned-patterns: clean
PASS keyword-stuffing: density 0.42% (<2%), in 0/7 H2s (<=30%)
PASS offer-accuracy: prices match config
PASS quotes: no long quotes
PASS schema: BlogPosting/Organization/FAQPage/BreadcrumbList inputs valid
PASS readability: Flesch-Kincaid grade 5.7 (<=9)
PASS style: sd 6.5, 2.5 contractions/100w
PASS variety: differs from recent posts
PASS build: npm run build succeeded
PASS jsonld-validate: JSON-LD, titles, canonicals valid
PASS performance: mobile performance median 100 of [99, 100, 100] (>=90)
